Destructing

Object Destructing

name = John

Array Destructing

const [first, second, third] = ["one","two","three"]

first = one

third = three

Function Destructing

const add = (a, b) => a + b;
const sum = add(1, 2);
const subtract = ({ a, b }) => a - b;
const difference = subtract({ a: 4, b: 2 });
sum = 3
difference = 2

Client Component Demo

You should have seen an alert pop up when the page loaded.

alert() is a browser API — it only exists in the browser, so this code can only run on the client.

If you removed 'use client', the build would fail becausealert is undefined on the server.
